title: Bhekiswayo Trust, Masoyi (area only, approx.): man, 30, dies after shoot-out with police; police are a party, 20 Oct
summary: Police say a 30-year-old Bhekiswayo Trust man attacked his 73-year-old father with a blunt object, damaged his father's safe and went to a local tavern with a firearm. Officers found he had locked himself inside his pare...
story: Police say a 30-year-old Bhekiswayo Trust man attacked his 73-year-old father with a blunt object, damaged his father's safe and went to a local tavern with a firearm. Officers found he had locked himself inside his parental home; they went in through a window, he fired at an officer and wounded him, and police returned fire, hitting him in the lower body. He later died at a medical facility on or after Tuesday 20 October; his father survived (SAPS spokesperson Colonel Mavela Masondo, via Lowvelder; SAPS Mpumalanga statement of 21 October). Cases of attempted murder (the father and the officer), possession of an unlicensed firearm and an inquest were opened; SAPS and IPID are investigating. Police are a party to this death, and police are the only source: there is no independent account. He is not named in the reports. One report: Lowvelder, 22 October. The pin is approximate (area level).
